item.text: I’m applying the planning output contract and the unattended UAT policy: selecting the narrowest conventional operational failure contract and recording it as a decision, while mapping every required Sea Trial to its owning story.

=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story architecture
summary:      Establish the Go module and application boundaries.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:        go.md
provides:     Go module and application package layout
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Establish the Go module and package boundaries required by the command-line application. Keep the implementation in Go 1.22 or newer and use only the standard library. Define clear ownership for command startup, CLI behavior, scanning, and output formatting. Do not read or modify files under the directory being examined.

## story build-executable
summary:      Provide the dupfind executable and build contract.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Build.md
covers:       DEL-001
accepts:       st-003
depends:       architecture
stack:         go.md
provides:      ./cmd/dupfind
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Provide the main package at ./cmd/dupfind and ensure the application root builds it with go build ./cmd/dupfind using only the standard library.

## story command-options
summary:      Parse command options and validate the directory argument.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Command.md
covers:       CLI-001
accepts:       st-007
depends:       build-executable
stack:         go.md
consumes:      ./cmd/dupfind
provides:      dupfind command-line options and usage
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Implement the documented command syntax, --summary, --min-size, help text, and validation of options and the single directory argument. Malformed arguments return exit code 2 and write no standard output. Missing or non-directory paths return exit code 1 and write no standard output. Operational diagnostics go to standard error.

## story scan-and-group
summary:      Find exact duplicate regular files in a directory tree.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Scanning.md
covers:       CLI-002
accepts:       st-004, st-005, st-008
depends:       command-options
stack:         go.md
consumes:      dupfind command-line options and usage
provides:      duplicate groups from a directory tree
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Recursively examine regular files, including hidden paths, without following or reporting symbolic links. Ignore zero-byte files and files smaller than the selected minimum size. Group by size before reading contents, then by SHA-256 digest. Skip unreadable files with one warning on standard error and do not change the exit code. Only read examined files; never delete, move, or write anything under the examined directory.

## story order-results
summary:      Order duplicate groups and paths deterministically.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Ordering.md
covers:       CLI-003
accepts:       st-004
depends:       scan-and-group
stack:         go.md
consumes:      duplicate groups from a directory tree
provides:      ordered duplicate groups and relative paths
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Order groups by reclaimable bytes descending and then digest ascending. Number groups from 1 in that order. Order paths within each group by byte value and emit paths relative to the requested directory using / separators without a leading ./.

## story listing-csv
summary:      Write the duplicate listing as CSV.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Listing.md
covers:       OUT-001
accepts:       st-004
depends:       order-results
stack:         go.md
consumes:      ordered duplicate groups and relative paths
provides:      default CSV listing
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Write the default listing to standard output with encoding/csv. Emit the specified header and one row per file in each duplicate group, with lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digests. With no duplicates, emit only the header. Use newline line endings and RFC 4180 field quoting.

## story summary-csv
summary:      Write duplicate group and reclaimable-space totals.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Summary.md
covers:       OUT-002
accepts:       st-006
depends:       order-results
stack:         go.md
consumes:      ordered duplicate groups and relative paths
provides:      --summary CSV output
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  When --summary is selected, emit the specified CSV header and one data row containing the number of duplicate groups, the sum of files minus one per group, and total reclaimable bytes. With no duplicates, emit zero for all totals. Derive the summary from the same duplicate groups as the listing.

## story test-harness
summary:      Provide the project quality test entry point.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Tests.md
covers:       DEL-002
accepts:       st-002
depends:       build-executable
stack:         go.md, common.md
provides:      bin/test.sh
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Provide a POSIX-compatible bin/test.sh that runs go vet ./... and go test ./... from the application root. Exit zero only when both commands pass.

## story conformance-grader
summary:      Pass the supplied duplicate-finder conformance grader.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   VERIFICATION.md
covers:       DEL-003
accepts:       st-001
depends:       architecture, build-executable, command-options, scan-and-group, order-results, listing-csv, summary-csv, test-harness
context:       sources/run.sh
context_roles: |
  sources/run.sh: conformance harness
stack:         go.md, common.md
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Run the supplied sources/run.sh from the completed application root and require its exit status to be zero. Do not modify, rewrite, regenerate, or substitute the supplied harness.

=== END ARTIFACT ===
